name: multi-agent-governor
description: Evidence-based admission and stopping decisions for multi-agent work

interface.shortDescription: Decide when more agents are worth using.
interface.longDescription: Start from one measured baseline, then decide whether another homogeneous agent is justified, which collaboration topology fits, and when to stop. This plugin produces an auditable plan; it does not launch or orchestrate agents.
defaultPrompt: Decide whether this task needs more agents.
Review this agent run and tell me whether to stop.
Plan an agent budget for this task.
